english.title: Registered person fail to display Care Quality Commission performance rating at principal place of business
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[service provider]_
(B)_[registered manager]_

in respect of a regulated activity, namely **(..SPECIFY ACTIVITY..), when there was not displayed at

(C)_[your]_
(D)_[the service provider's]_

principal place of business at least one sign showing the most recent rating of

(E)_[your]_
(F)_[the service provider's]_

overall performance, and
(G)_[your]_
(H)_[its]_

performance in relation to particular premises or activities, in a way which made it clear to which activities or premises a particular rating related, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES OR ACTIVITIES..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 20A(5), 22(1)(e) and 23(5A) of the Health and Social Care Act 2008 (Regulated Activities) Regulations 2014.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
were the registered manager person in respect of a registered activity
when there was not displayed at the service provider's principal place of business at least one sign
showing the most recent rating of the service provider's overall performance
and its performance in relation to particular premises or activities
in a way which made it clear to which activities or premises a particular rating related

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 8(1) and (2) provides that a registered person must comply with regulations 9 to 20A in carrying on a regulated activity, unless the thing to be done has by another registered person in relation to the regulated activity concerned.
(ii) As per regulation 22(4), it is a defence for a registered person to prove that they took all reasonable steps and exercised all due diligence to prevent the breach.
